plan.name: Generated gates check repository plans
plan.summary: Add invariant check-repository for CI, loading .invariant/repository.json only through internal/repository at a resolved committed base and using the existing dependency preparation, offline sandbox, native adapters, time allowances, cleanup and phase reporting; missing configuration preserves modeled-only operation, while invalid configuration or failed checks fail the command. For factory changes, verify the issue's ratified plan, original and current execution authority, scope and pinned acceptance sources before running the affected parts and exact native selectors, including admitted regressions; ordinary pull requests use captured ownership and push runs or unreliable selections check every configured part. Extend the generated gate to run these checks, independently discover modeled projects and plan records for guarded ratification, and retain branch-derived factory scope, the full Invariant revision pin, read-only permissions, modeled verification, receipt and trace upload and the invariant/gate job name. Extend setup and watcher preflight to reject obsolete configured gates with actionable manual upgrade guidance while preserving modeled-only compatibility, customized workflows and reviewed init drafts. Update SPEC.md with supporting decision citations, README.md within 400 lines and docs/factory.md for the command, authority and upgrade procedure, keep external plumbing intake disabled and Invariant's own CI unchanged, and require the merger to record this step's new decision with invariant decisions decide before the next step under D-0122/D-0294.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate736FactoryLanguages
tests.says: The CI command loads real committed contracts and ratified native plans for Go, pytest, Vitest, Jest and a mixed repository, prepares locked dependencies before offline commands and exact native tests, and confines a one-part factory change to that part.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate736Failures
tests.says: Every declared check and native test can fail CI; missing completion, dependency, cleanup and cancellation failures cannot pass, and skipped and unstarted phases keep their reasons.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate736Authority
tests.says: Real scope and ratification reject missing or wrong ratifications, altered or removed pinned tests, invalid execution authority, unplanned changes and candidate configuration attempts to bypass checks, before external execution.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate736OrdinaryCI
tests.says: Ordinary pull requests select committed ownership, shared changes select their owners, and push or unreliable change selection runs all parts; malformed committed contracts fail and working-tree configuration never supplies authority.

tests.name: TestRepositoryGate736CLIAndUpgrade
tests.says: The command is dispatched and documented, unconfigured CI needs no Docker, init explains manual gate upgrades without overwriting custom workflows, and CLI setup preflight distinguishes configured from modeled-only committed bases.

tests.name: TestGeneratedGate736RunsRepositoryChecks
tests.says: The generated invariant/gate invokes repository checks for PRs and pushes with committed base authority and propagates failure, while retaining its pin, permissions, modeled verification and artifact upload.

tests.name: TestGeneratedGate736RatifiesPlansIndependently
tests.says: Executing generated shell steps with fake external commands proves plan-only and mixed ratification, the empty modeled-only guard, failure propagation and branch-derived factory scope.

tests.name: TestConfiguredGate736RequiresCapabilities
tests.says: Configured setup refuses a job-name-only or incomplete gate with manual upgrade guidance, accepts the generated gate, preserves legacy modeled-only requirements, and does not count comments or another job's checks as gate capabilities.
